Request one-pagers and demo videos

Every industry solution in the Agent Library has a published one-pager and a filmed demo on the AIBAST SharePoint. Tell us which solutions you want to see and we will send you access.

What the form asks: your name and work email, which industry solutions you are interested in, and what you plan to use them for. If you are Microsoft internal, add your MSX ID; it is only required for Microsoft-internal requesters.

Everything you can build yourself stays here: the Copilot Studio solution ZIPs, the RAPP agents, and the Academy workshops need no request.

What happens after you submit. If the address you give belongs to a Microsoft account, you are added to the internal library automatically and the confirmation goes to the address on your directory record. Everyone else is reviewed by a person, usually within a working day.

The confirmation always goes to the directory address rather than the one typed into the form, so a mistyped or borrowed address cannot send the library somewhere it should not go.

If the form does not load here, open it in a new tab.
